remaining_user_action: Look at the physical LCD after normal boot; confirm IP/pairing text is visible, complete and oriented correctly. Do not share the displayed secret values.
To physically accept KEY recovery: hold KEY during a board restart, confirm the protected AP/IP screen, then release it. A normal restart should return to the saved station network.

If desired, use a separate phone to join the existing protected board AP and open http://192.168.4.1; no Windows network setting change is needed. A saved-network-unavailable boot test remains separate.
